drivers.name: Lars Voss
drivers.archetype: The complete champion — elite everywhere
drivers.bio: Ice-cold under pressure, four-time champion material
drivers.backstory: Karted against future champions before he was ten and beat most of them; four titles later, teammates still call him unreadable on the radio.

drivers.name: Marcus Chen
drivers.archetype: Steady #2 — reliable points machine, not flashy
drivers.bio: The dependable points machine
drivers.backstory: Came up through Apex's junior academy grinding data reviews long after everyone else had gone home — the results only started catching up to the work ethic recently.

drivers.name: Enzo Rossi
drivers.archetype: Mercurial star — blistering pace, error-prone
drivers.bio: Mercurial genius — sublime or in the wall
drivers.backstory: A generational qualifying talent from a family of Italian tifosi royalty; every wall he's put a car into has come with a lap time nobody else could touch.

drivers.name: Niko Haas
drivers.archetype: Veteran wheel-to-wheel master — racecraft over raw pace
drivers.bio: Wily veteran, master of the late-braking move
drivers.backstory: Two decades on the grid and three different eras of cars — younger drivers ask him for setup advice, then wonder how he still out-brakes them into Turn 1.

drivers.name: Tomas Silva
drivers.archetype: Rain master — ordinary in the dry, sublime in the wet
drivers.bio: Turns into a magician the moment it rains
drivers.backstory: Grew up racing karts in tropical downpours back home; the wetter the forecast, the more his rivals start checking the radar themselves.

drivers.name: Jae Park
drivers.archetype: Tyre whisperer — makes a stint last forever
drivers.bio: Can make a set of tyres last forever
drivers.backstory: An engineer's son who reads a tyre graph like a novel — his stints outlast the strategy sheet more often than not.

drivers.name: Erik Berg
drivers.archetype: Qualifying specialist — one-lap pace, fades in races
drivers.bio: Qualifying flyer, Sunday is harder
drivers.backstory: Set three junior-series pole records before he'd turned twenty; Sunday afternoons have been a slower education.

drivers.name: Rui Almeida
drivers.archetype: Aggressive overtaker — fearless, occasionally reckless
drivers.bio: Fearless overtaker, sometimes too fearless
drivers.backstory: Fearless to a fault — his overtakes make the highlight reel as often as the stewards' inbox.

drivers.name: Petr Novak
drivers.archetype: Metronome — never makes mistakes, never spectacular
drivers.bio: A metronome — never puts a wheel wrong
drivers.backstory: A driving instructor by trade before F1, obsessed with doing the same lap the same way a hundred times in a row.

drivers.name: Ren Ito
drivers.archetype: Balanced midfielder — quietly competent
drivers.bio: Quietly quick, quietly consistent
drivers.backstory: Rarely the fastest in any single session, but somehow always the one still there at the end of a long, messy race.

drivers.name: Theo Dubois
drivers.archetype: Consistent points-scorer — dependable midfield
drivers.bio: Reliable, intelligent, banks the points
drivers.backstory: A former engineering student who treats every race like a spreadsheet to be optimised — unglamorous, but the points add up.

drivers.name: David Mwangi
drivers.archetype: Rising talent — raw but improving fast
drivers.bio: Raw talent rising fast through the ranks
drivers.backstory: The first driver from his country to reach a top series; still finding the ceiling of a talent everyone agrees is real.

drivers.name: Kasper Olsen
drivers.archetype: Smooth operator — gentle on a fragile car
drivers.bio: Smooth hands, kind to fragile machinery
drivers.backstory: Learned to drive smooth on his father's rally car — a touch light enough that Halcyon's fragile machinery somehow survives a whole race under him.

drivers.name: Carlos Reyes
drivers.archetype: Wildcard — flashes of brilliance, inconsistent
drivers.bio: Flashes of brilliance, maddening inconsistency
drivers.backstory: Capable of a podium-worthy weekend and a wall-worthy one in back-to-back races; nobody's figured out which one is coming next.

drivers.name: Lena Fischer
drivers.archetype: Calculating racer — strategic, patient
drivers.bio: The thinking driver — strategy in her bones
drivers.backstory: Studied motorsport strategy academically before racing it — she reads a race like she's already seen the replay.

drivers.name: Milan Kovac
drivers.archetype: Hard-charging journeyman — gives everything
drivers.bio: Gives 100% every lap, every race
drivers.backstory: A journeyman who's driven for more teams than anyone on the current grid; still races every lap like it's a title decider.

drivers.name: Bruno Santos
drivers.archetype: Hungry rookie — high ceiling, learning the ropes
drivers.bio: Hungry rookie with a sky-high ceiling
drivers.backstory: The most-hyped rookie in a decade back home in Argentina — the car underneath him hasn't caught up to the talent yet.

drivers.name: Wei Tan
drivers.archetype: Experienced anchor — steadies a young team
drivers.bio: The steady hand steadying a young team
drivers.backstory: The senior head in a young garage, more valued for keeping the team calm on a bad Sunday than for outright pace.

drivers.name: Alexei Petrov
drivers.archetype: Backmarker grinder — maximises a slow car
drivers.bio: Squeezes every tenth from a slow car
drivers.backstory: Sixteen seasons deep in cars that were never going to win — colleagues call him the most underrated driver never to get a top seat.

drivers.name: Jordan Kane
drivers.archetype: Pay-driver with heart — limited but committed
drivers.bio: Heart of a lion, budget of a minnow
drivers.backstory: Brought sponsorship money and genuine heart to a struggling team; still logging laps and chasing the pace every single weekend.
